seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

def get_pink():
    result = []
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color'] == 'B':
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            parent_color = None
            for other in nodes:

    result.sort()
    return [h for _, h in result]

action(['DOWN'])
